_comment: Spec 14 (android platform + data migration). Deterministic vectors generated with Node crypto / JDK 17; IVs are fixed ONLY for testing - production always uses random IVs. Inventories are generated from a full scan of ../lib (every SharedPreferences / flutter_secure_storage call site, constants resolved).

fss_v10_gcm.description: Value stored in shared_prefs/FlutterSecureStorage.xml by flutter_secure_storage 10.3.4 (StorageCipherImplementationGCM). Stored string = android.util.Base64.encodeToString(iv||ciphertext||tag, DEFAULT) i.e. 76-char lines + trailing newline. XML attribute name = PREFIX + "_" + logicalKey.

fss_v9_cbc.description: Legacy AES-128-CBC/PKCS7 value (only reachable via a _BACKUP or marker-driven migration state). Stored = Base64.DEFAULT(iv16||ciphertext).

badge_blob.description: Value of flutter.badges_encrypted (and preserved/older/incoming/pending, badges_former[].blob, secure copy badges_encrypted). Dart base64 = standard alphabet WITH padding, no line breaks. Badge key = 64 lowercase hex chars stored in secure key badge_encryption_key.

flutter_shared_prefs.description: shared_preferences_android 2.4.20 legacy plugin: file shared_prefs/FlutterSharedPreferences.xml, every key prefixed "flutter.". Dart setInt -> <long>, setBool -> <boolean>, setString -> <string>, setDouble -> <string> DOUBLE_PREFIX + Java Double.toString, setStringList -> <string> LIST_PREFIX + "!" + Dart jsonEncode(list).

flutter_shared_prefs.notes: Keys without the "flutter." prefix are not visible to the Dart app and must be ignored. Non-ASCII characters are NOT \u-escaped by Dart jsonEncode.

legacyJavaSerializedList.description: Pre-2.3 shared_preferences_android list encoding (no '!'): LIST_PREFIX + android.util.Base64.encodeToString(ObjectOutputStream(ArrayList<String>), DEFAULT). DEFAULT = 76-char lines joined by '\n' plus a trailing '\n'. Not written by 2.4.20 but must still decode (plugin decodes it with StringListObjectInputStream allow-list).

doubleEncoding.description: setDouble stores DOUBLE_PREFIX + java.lang.Double.toString(value); decode with String.toDouble() after the prefix.

difficulty.note: Dart toStringAsFixed(1) rounds half away from zero on the binary value; -3.75 is exact in binary -> "-3.8"
Dart toStringAsFixed works on the exact binary value (1.4499999999999999556) -> 1.4. Java String.format("%.1f") gives 1.5 (WRONG). Use BigDecimal(abs(pct)).setScale(1, HALF_UP).
negative values keep the '-' even when they round to 0.0 (Dart/JS toFixed). No '+' because pct < 0.

hashrate.note: toStringAsFixed(0): exact tie rounds away from zero

widget_formatting.localeNote: Always format with Locale.ROOT digits; group separator '.' is inserted manually (fmtInt), never via NumberFormat(Locale.GERMANY).

fss_constants.valueEncoding: android.util.Base64.encodeToString(bytes, 0 /*DEFAULT*/) - 76-char lines + trailing newline; decode with Base64.DEFAULT

storage_eras.secrets: FlutterSharedPreferences flutter.nostr_nsec_key / flutter.nostr_npub_key / flutter.nostr_priv_hex; badges as plaintext list flutter.badges

FlutterSecureStorage.xml = ESP (names AES256-SIV, values AES256-GCM, Tink keysets in the same file, master key _androidx_security_master_key_). Fallback if ESP init failed: custom AES-CBC + RSA-PKCS1 in the same file.
FlutterSecureStorage.xml entries <prefix>_<key> = Base64(iv12||ct||tag) AES-128-GCM, key wrapped RSA-OAEP. ESP entries from E1 may remain ORPHANED in the same file (see spec 14 F1).
